payload.core_mechanism_summary: 2D DP table indexed by start and end letters, updated with each name to maximize dynasty length.
payload.rationale: The solution uses a 26x26 array dp[j][a] representing max length of a name sequence starting with letter j and ending with letter a. It updates dp[j][b] by extending existing sequences and initializes dp[a][b] with the current name's length. This matches dp_2d_state.
